shortBulletSummary: Geopolitical tensions from potential US strike on Iran and Strait of Hormuz attacks fuel inflation fears, pressuring crypto.
Bitcoin and Ethereum saw slight declines; $222M in liquidations hit crypto markets, mostly long positions.
Crypto Fear & Greed Index is currently "Neutral" at 44, down from "Greed" levels earlier in the week.
Federal Reserve rate hike probabilities recently collapsed from 51% to 14.9%, easing tightening fears.
Nine crypto groups formed a Quantum Alliance to set quantum-resistant standards for digital assets.
